verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is a government IP-registration service, not an agent, so an official MCP server for searching or filing is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence covers only patent, trademark and design procedures, and the llms.txt probe returned 404, showing no agent-oriented docs are published. Nothing in the pack documents an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
